55. MAINTENANCE ALLOWANCE FOR LEPROSY AFFECTED PERSONS 
 
  
1 
Gist of the Scheme 
Maintenance allowance is given at the rate of         Rs. 
1,500/- per month to leprosy affected persons. The 
inmates 
accommodated 
in 
the 
Government 
Rehabilitation Homes are eligible to receive this 
allowance and deposited in their S.B account directly 
from Treasury through ECS. 
2 
Eligibility Criteria 
Leprosy affected with deformity of  40% and above. 
3 
Whether the prescribed 
application from is 
available 
Yes. Prescribed application is available with District 
Differently Abled Welfare Officer. 
4 
Certificates to be furnished 
National identity card for differently abled and family
card. A certificate from doctor stating that the applicant is 
not curable by surgical/other means, bank account details. 
5 
Officer to whom the 
application is to be 
submitted 
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer 
6 
Grievances if any to be 
addressed to 
Assistant Special Officer,  
O/o. The Commissionerate  for Welfare of the 
Differently abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940
